motor_comprehensive.policyText:
MOTOR COMPREHENSIVE POLICY
Coverage: The policy covers own damage to the insured vehicle due to accident, collision, overturning, fire, explosion, lightning, theft, flood, cyclone, storm, earthquake, riot, strike, malicious acts and terrorism. Third-party liability for bodily injury, death and property damage is included. Cashless repairs at network garages and roadside assistance are available.
Exclusions: The insurer shall not be liable for any claim arising from driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs, racing, speed testing, use of the vehicle for commercial hire, driving without a valid licence, intentional damage, war, nuclear risks, or wear and tear. Exclusions apply to consequential loss and contractual liability.

health_comprehensive.policyText:
HEALTH COMPREHENSIVE POLICY
Coverage: In-patient hospitalization, day-care procedures, pre and post hospitalization expenses, ambulance charges, modern treatments, and cashless treatment at network hospitals are covered.
Waiting periods: Pre-existing diseases are covered only after a continuous waiting period of 48 months. Maternity is covered after 24 months. The initial waiting period is 30 days except for accidents.
Exclusions: Cosmetic surgery, self-inflicted injury, suicide attempt, war, nuclear risks, routine health check-ups, and treatment taken during the initial waiting period are excluded.

crop_pmfby.policyText:
PRADHAN MANTRI FASAL BIMA YOJANA (PMFBY)
Coverage: The scheme covers crop loss due to drought, flood, cyclone, hailstorm, pests, crop diseases, excess rainfall, prevented sowing, post-harvest loss for notified crops, and localized calamities.
Exclusions: Farmer negligence or improper farming practices, crops not notified by the state, post-harvest losses beyond the notified period, non-compliance with scheme rules, and false claims are excluded.
Claims: Claims are triggered when actual yield falls below threshold yield and are aimed to be settled within about two months after final yield data.

travel_guard.policyText:
TRAVEL GUARD POLICY
Coverage: Emergency medical treatment and hospitalization abroad, emergency medical evacuation, dental emergencies due to accident, trip cancellation or interruption for covered reasons, loss or delay of checked-in baggage, and personal accident cover in many variants.
Exclusions: Pre-existing illnesses, adventure sports and high-risk activities unless an add-on is purchased, travel against medical advice, war and terrorism, and claims arising from intoxication are excluded.

home_shield.policyText:
HOME SHIELD POLICY
Coverage: Loss or damage to building and contents due to fire, lightning, explosion, flood, storm, cyclone, earthquake if opted, burglary, theft, housebreaking, and electrical or mechanical breakdown of specified appliances if selected. Reconstruction or repair and alternative accommodation rent are covered as per limits.
Exclusions: Wear and tear, gradual deterioration, war, nuclear risks, intentional damage, and loss while the home is unoccupied for more than 30 consecutive days are excluded.

life_jeevan.policyText:
LIC JEEVAN UMANG POLICY
Coverage: Provides life cover up to age 100 with a guaranteed annual survival benefit of 8% of basic sum assured after the premium paying term, and a maturity benefit at age 100. Death benefit is payable to the nominee on death during the policy term.
Exclusions: Suicide within 12 months from commencement or revival, fraudulent misrepresentation, and death due to war or nuclear perils are excluded.

pa_cover.policyText:
PERSONAL ACCIDENT POLICY
Coverage: Accidental death benefit up to 100% of sum insured, permanent total disability, permanent partial disability as per injury scale, temporary total disability weekly compensation, and accidental hospitalization expenses.
Exclusions: No cover for death or disability not due to an accident, self-harm or suicide attempt, intentional injury, injury under the influence of alcohol or drugs beyond legal limits, criminal acts, war, civil commotion, or terrorism.
